description: Score how likely a passage reads as AI-written, fully on-device, with a per-signal breakdown and a confidence band. Returns a 0 to 100 likelihood, never a yes/no verdict. The signal is directional and biased against non-native English writers, so treat it as a second opinion and not proof. Get a read here, then call find_ai_tells to locate the spans worth rewriting.
name: detect_ai_text
title: Detect AI text
